scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply camatrimony-db --remote
scripts.db:migrate-local: cd apps/api && pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply camatrimony-db --local
scripts.db:seed-local: cd apps/api && pnpm exec wrangler d1 execute camatrimony-db --local --file=../../scripts/seed-local-matches.sql
scripts.db:seed-local-admin: cd apps/api && pnpm exec wrangler d1 execute camatrimony-db --local --file=../../scripts/seed-local-admin.sql
scripts.test:platform: pnpm --filter './packages/*' build && node --test scripts/matching.test.mjs scripts/profile-validation.test.mjs && node scripts/platform-regression.test.mjs
scripts.build:cloudflare: pnpm --filter './packages/*' build && pnpm --filter @camatrimony/web build:cloudflare && pnpm --filter @camatrimony/admin build:cloudflare && pnpm build:api
